subject: Invoice-splitting guidance & PO validation for consolidated billing
messages:
From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@stellaris.health>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@stellaris.health
Date: Tue, 02 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor enrollment & invoicing requirements for Stellaris Health - next steps

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed with the latency and routing controls. Procurement asked I kick off vendor enrollment so we can bind Redwood as a supplier in our AP system and start issuing POs. A couple of constraints we need to surface up front: 

- We operate multiple legal entities across the US and EU. We will issue a separate PO per legal entity but prefer a single consolidated invoice from Redwood that includes a per-entity breakdown (line items grouped under each entity).
- Our AP portal requires each invoice to validate against the issuing PO number and the remit-to account. We can accept one invoice with multiple PO references, but it needs a clear entity-level subtotal and remittances mapped to the correct remit account.
- Tax: for US entities we need Redwood's EIN/TIN and completed W-9. For EU shipments/placements, we need VAT IDs and any VAT reverse-charge self-billing confirmations.
- Payment terms: standard net30, but some of our divisions have 45-day cadence; we need flexibility in the invoice scheduling.

Can you confirm if Redwood can: (1) produce a consolidated invoice with entity-level subtotals and mapping to multiple remit accounts, and (2) provide a PO validation spreadsheet we can use to test the portal?

If you can share an onboarding packet and example invoice CSV/format we will upload Redwood to our portal this week. Also please provide a single point of contact on finance for any follow-ups.

Thanks,
Elena Morris
Vendor Enablement / Stellaris Health
elena.morris@stellaris.health
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment(s): none in initial email
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@stellaris.health>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 02 Oct 2028 10:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment & invoicing requirements for Stellaris Health - next steps

Hi Elena — great to hear, thanks for the clear constraints. I attached our AP onboarding packet and a PO validation/invoice-split template (Excel) that the portal team can use for a dry run. Summary answers below and next steps.

Short answers
- Consolidated invoice with entity subtotals: yes — we can produce a single invoice PDF/CSV that contains separate sections per purchasing legal entity and line-level PO references.
- Multiple remit accounts: we support multiple remit accounts on our side and can map specific line-item totals to different remit bank details in the CSV stub.
- Tax docs: we can provide W-9 (US EIN) and VAT certificates for EU entities; will share via DocuSign for signatures.
- Payment cadence: we can support net30 by default and honor net45 for specific divisions; we’ll record per-PO payment terms in our system so the invoice schedule aligns.

Open questions for your AP team (please reply inline or we can sync briefly):
1) Portal limits: can your portal accept more than 10 PO references on a single invoice? Any character limits on PO fields?
2) Remit mapping: does the portal require separate invoices per remit account, or will a CSV/line-level remit-to identifier suffice?
3) Test mode: can you provide a sandbox upload URL and an account we can use to push 2 test invoices (one consolidated across three POs/entities, one single-entity)?

Next steps I propose:
- I: Redwood -> upload: RI_AP_Onboarding_Packet_v1.pdf and PO-Validation-and-Invoice-Split-Template.xlsx (attached)
- II: Stellaris -> provision portal credentials and confirm sandbox upload URL
- III: Redwood -> push two test invoices the week of Oct 9 for validation; iterate on header/field mapping

Point of contact on finance: Rishi Malhotra (rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai) — copying him for any mapping/validation clarifications. Naomi will own tax docs and certificate collection.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-minute call if that speeds things up.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
(650) 555-0133

Attachment(s): RI_AP_Onboarding_Packet_v1.pdf, PO-Validation-and-Invoice-Split-Template.xlsx
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 03 Oct 2028 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Vendor enrollment & invoicing requirements for Stellaris Health - next steps

Marissa / Naomi — forwarding procurement request and Marissa's packet. Quick finance checklist and recommended validations before test uploads: 

Finance checklist (recommended)
- Header-level: invoice_number, invoice_date, consolidated_invoice_id (if present), total_amount, currency
- PO validation: accept up to 20 PO refs on an invoice; each PO must match pattern [STL-][0-9]{6} — confirm with Elena but we can parameterize pattern in our mapping table.
- Line-level: require fields: PO_number, line_item_id, description, quantity, unit_price, tax_code, entity_code
- Entity mapping: entity_code must match Stellaris legal entity identifier in their portal; we will send a sample mapping file.
- Remit mapping: include remit_account_id per line; if portal cannot honor line-level remit, we will split into per-remit invoices during generation.
- Tax: require TIN/EIN on the vendor profile upload and VAT id(s) for EU entities. For EU reverse-charge items, include tax_reason_code in the CSV and a pointer to the VAT certificate.

Operational notes
- Test plan: two test invoices (consolidated multi-entity; single-entity) + one negative test to confirm portal rejects malformed PO.
- Cutover: recommend run on a Thursday evening to align with Stellaris payment cycle; allow two business days for portal processing.
- Audit trail: include an attachments folder in the invoice payload with references to W-9 / VAT cert DocuSign envelope ids.

I can produce the mapping CSV and a small validation script (Python) to simulate their portal checks. Naomi — please prepare W-9 and EU VAT certs for the entities listed in the onboarding packet; we'll send DocuSign links.

Rishi
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

Attachment(s): none
From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@stellaris.health>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@stellaris.health
Date: Wed, 03 Oct 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment & invoicing requirements for Stellaris Health - next steps

Marissa — thanks for the packet and Rishi for the checklist. We will: 

- Upload Redwood as a vendor to our portal today and provision a sandbox account. Credentials and upload URL attached (stellaris-portal-invite-link.txt).
- Confirm PO pattern: STL-###### (we'll include exact regex in the portal notes) — portal accepts up to 30 PO refs.
- Remit: portal supports line-level remit mapping (remit_id) in our CSV; no need to split invoices.
- Tax docs: I'll send a DocuSign envelope that requests W-9 for Redwood US entity and VAT self-certificates for the EU entity. Expect the DocuSign link in a separate email (we generally require signed certs before processing first invoice).
- Payment cadence: our central finance team will honor the invoice-level payment term flagged in the consolidated invoice; include per-PO terms as metadata.

We will push the sandbox credentials to you and plan to test Wednesday, Oct 11. If everything passes, we'll flip to production the following Wednesday (Oct 18).

Thanks again — looking forward to getting Redwood live.

Regards,
Elena Morris
Vendor Enablement / Stellaris Health

Attachment(s): stellaris-portal-invite-link.txt
